mapper.sql: (select count(*) from cm_task_item required_item where required_item.task_id=t.id and required_item.item_order in (1,2) and exists (select 1 from cm_task_attempt a where a.task_item_id=required_item.id and a.attempt_no=1 and a.status='completed')) < 2
mapper.select: select id,user_id,certification_id,syllabus_version_id,target_exam_year,target_exam_month from cm_user_goal where user_id=#{userId} and status='active' order by update_time desc,id desc limit 1

select id,user_id,certification_id,syllabus_version_id,target_exam_year,target_exam_month from cm_user_goal where user_id=#{userId} and status='active' order by update_time desc,id desc limit 1 for update
select id,user_id,certification_id,syllabus_version_id,target_exam_year,target_exam_month from cm_user_goal where id=#{goalId} and status='active' for update
select id from cm_user_goal where status='active' order by id offset #{offset} limit #{limit}
select count(*)::int from cm_learning_task t where t.user_id=#{userId} and t.goal_id=#{goalId} and

select count(*) from cm_learning_task t where t.user_id=#{userId} and t.goal_id=#{goalId} and
and (t.display_snapshot->>'title' ilike concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or t.display_snapshot->>'knowledgePoint' ilike concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))

select s.id,s.source_task_id,s.status, exists(select 1 from cm_task_item ti join cm_task_attempt a on a.task_item_id=ti.id where ti.task_id=s.source_task_id and ti.item_order=1 and a.attempt_no=1 and a.status='completed') learning_completed from cm_learning_session s where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.goal_id=#{goalId} and s.session_type='daily_task' and s.status in ('created','in_progress','submitted','settling') order by s.create_time,s.id limit 1 for update

select t.id,t.user_id,t.goal_id,t.exam_subject_id,t.rule_version_id, (select ti.id from cm_task_item ti where ti.task_id=t.id and ti.item_order=1 and ti.item_type='knowledge') knowledge_item_id, (select ti.id from cm_task_item ti where ti.task_id=t.id and ti.item_order=2 and ti.item_type='question') question_item_id, coalesce((select (ti.target_data->>'questionCount')::int from cm_task_item ti where ti.task_id=t.id and ti.item_order=2),0) question_count, (select count(*) from cm_task_item ti where ti.task_id=t.id and ti.item_order in(1,2) and exists(select 1 from cm_task_attempt a where a.task_item_id=ti.id and a.attempt_no=1 and a.status='completed'))=2 completed from cm_learning_task t where t.id=#{taskId} and t.user_id=#{userId} and t.goal_id=#{goalId} for update

select t.id task_id,ti.estimated_minutes,ti.target_data::text target_data from cm_learning_task t join cm_task_item ti on ti.task_id=t.id where t.id=#{taskId} and t.user_id=#{userId} and t.goal_id=#{goalId} and ti.item_order=1 and ti.item_type='knowledge'

select s.id,s.source_task_id,s.status, exists(select 1 from cm_task_item ti join cm_task_attempt a on a.task_item_id=ti.id where ti.task_id=s.source_task_id and ti.item_order=1 and a.attempt_no=1 and a.status='completed') learning_completed from cm_learning_session s where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.goal_id=#{goalId} and s.source_task_id=#{taskId} and s.session_type='daily_task' order by s.id limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into cm_learning_session(id,user_id,goal_id,exam_subject_id,session_type,status,rule_version_id, request_id,source_task_id,certification_id,syllabus_version_id,target_exam_year,target_exam_month,row_version) values(#{id},#{userId},#{goal.id},#{task.examSubjectId},'daily_task','created',#{task.ruleVersionId}, #{requestId},#{task.id},#{goal.certificationId},#{goal.syllabusVersionId},#{goal.targetExamYear}, #{goal.targetExamMonth},0) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select question_id,question_revision_id,exam_subject_id,evidence_group_key,difficulty_snapshot difficulty, estimated_seconds_snapshot estimated_seconds,presentation_snapshot::text,grading_snapshot::text, knowledge_snapshot::text from cm_task_question where task_item_id=#{taskItemId} order by question_order
mapper.insert: insert into cm_session_question(id,session_id,question_id,question_revision_id,exam_subject_id,question_order, evidence_group_key,difficulty_snapshot,estimated_seconds_snapshot,presentation_snapshot,grading_snapshot, knowledge_snapshot,hint_allowed) values(#{id},#{sessionId},#{question.questionId},#{question.questionRevisionId},#{question.examSubjectId}, #{order},#{question.evidenceGroupKey},#{question.difficulty},#{question.estimatedSeconds}, #{question.presentationSnapshot}::jsonb,#{question.gradingSnapshot}::jsonb, #{question.knowledgeSnapshot}::jsonb,true) on conflict do nothing
insert into cm_task_attempt(id,task_item_id,session_id,attempt_no,status,started_time) values(#{id},#{taskItemId},#{sessionId},1,'started',now()) on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update cm_learning_session set status='in_progress',started_time=coalesce(started_time,now()), status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and status='created'

update cm_task_attempt set status='completed',completed_time=coalesce(completed_time,now()),update_time=now() where task_item_id=#{taskItemId} and session_id=#{sessionId} and attempt_no=1 and status='started'

update cm_task_attempt a set status='completed',completed_time=coalesce(completed_time,now()),update_time=now() from cm_task_item ti,cm_learning_task t,cm_learning_session s,cm_user_goal g where a.task_item_id=ti.id and ti.task_id=t.id and s.id=a.session_id and s.source_task_id=t.id and g.id=s.goal_id and g.user_id=#{userId} and g.status='active' and s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type='daily_task' and ti.item_type='question' and ti.item_order=2 and a.attempt_no=1 and a.status='started' and exists(select 1 from cm_task_item li join cm_task_attempt la on la.task_item_id=li.id where li.task_id=t.id and li.item_type='knowledge' and li.item_order=1 and la.session_id=s.id and la.attempt_no=1 and la.status='completed')
mapper.select: select id,payload_hash,status,resource_id,response_status,response_body::text from cm_idempotency_record where action_code=#{actionCode} and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_idempotency_record(id,action_code,request_id,payload_hash,status,expires_time) values(#{id},#{actionCode},#{requestId},#{payloadHash},'processing',now()+interval '24 hours') on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update cm_idempotency_record set status='succeeded',resource_type=#{resourceType},resource_id=#{resourceId}, response_status=200,response_body=#{responseBody}::jsonb,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='processing'
update cm_idempotency_record set status='failed',response_status=#{responseStatus}, response_body=#{responseBody}::jsonb,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='processing'
mapper.select: select min(id) from cm_profile_rule_version where status='published' having count(*)=1
select count(*)::int from cm_profile_rule_version where status='published'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_task_replenishment_batch(id,user_id,goal_id,trigger_type,before_available_count, requested_count,created_count,rule_version_id,algorithm_version,input_snapshot,result_summary,status, request_id,generation_key) values(#{id},#{userId},#{goalId},#{triggerType},#{beforeCount},#{requestedCount},0,#{ruleVersionId}, 'TASK_RECOMMENDATION_V1',#{inputSnapshot}::jsonb,'{"schema_version":"1.0","createdTaskIds":[]}'::jsonb, 'generating',#{requestId},#{generationKey}) on conflict(generation_key) do nothing
mapper.select: select id from cm_task_replenishment_batch where generation_key=#{generationKey}
mapper.update: update cm_task_replenishment_batch set status='generating',before_available_count=#{beforeCount}, requested_count=#{requestedCount},created_count=0,rule_version_id=#{ruleVersionId}, input_snapshot=#{inputSnapshot}::jsonb, result_summary='{"schema_version":"1.0","createdTaskIds":[]}'::jsonb, failure_reason=null,update_time=now() where generation_key=#{generationKey} and status='failed'
mapper.select: select kp.id knowledge_point_id,kp.exam_subject_id,kp.syllabus_title knowledge_name, coalesce(profile.profile_status,'unassessed') profile_status, jsonb_build_object('schema_version',#{learningContentSchemaVersion}, 'title',concat(kp.syllabus_title,'专项学习'),'knowledgePoint',kp.syllabus_title, 'sections',content.blocks)::text content_snapshot from cm_knowledge_point kp left join cm_knowledge_profile profile on profile.user_id=#{userId} and profile.goal_id=#{goalId} and profile.knowledge_point_id=kp.id join lateral ( select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('order',c.section_order, 'title',coalesce(c.heading,d.title),'content',c.content, 'images',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('stableId',im.id::text, 'storagePath',im.storage_path,'altText',im.alt_text,'sortOrder',im.image_order) order by im.image_order,im.id) from cm_document_image im where im.chunk_id=c.id),'[]'::jsonb)) order by c.section_order) blocks from (select c.*,row_number() over(order by c.chunk_order,c.id)::int section_order from cm_chunk_knowledge ck join cm_document_chunk c on c.id=ck.chunk_id join cm_document d0 on d0.id=c.document_id where ck.knowledge_point_id=kp.id and d0.status='published' and d0.del_flag='0' order by c.chunk_order,c.id limit 3) c join cm_document d on d.id=c.document_id ) content on jsonb_array_length(content.blocks)>0 where kp.syllabus_version_id=#{syllabusVersionId} and kp.status='0' and kp.del_flag='0' and kp.recommendation_enabled=true and not exists(select 1 from cm_learning_task t join cm_task_item ti on ti.task_id=t.id where t.user_id=#{userId} and t.goal_id=#{goalId} and ti.knowledge_point_id=kp.id and ) and (select count(distinct qk.question_id) from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_question q on q.id=qk.question_id and q.del_flag='0' join cm_question_revision r on r.id=qk.question_revision_id and r.status='published' where qk.knowledge_point_id=kp.id and r.question_type='CHOICE' and jsonb_typeof(r.answer)='object' and jsonb_typeof(r.answer->'value')='array' and jsonb_exists(r.answer, 'schema_version') and r.answer->>'answer_type'='option_keys' and r.answer->>'selection_mode'='single' and jsonb_array_length(r.answer->'value')=1 and exists(select 1 from cm_question_option o where o.question_revision_id=r.id) and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(r.answer->'value') answer(label) where not exists(select 1 from cm_question_option o where o.question_revision_id=r.id and o.option_label=answer.label))) >= 1 order by case coalesce(profile.profile_status,'unassessed') when 'urgent' then 1 when 'weak' then 2 when 'needs_retest' then 3 when 'pending_verification' then 4 when 'needs_review' then 5 when 'expired' then 6 when 'unassessed' then 7 when 'provisional' then 8 when 'learning' then 9 when 'proficient' then 10 when 'mastery_candidate' then 11 when 'mastered' then 12 else 13 end, kp.importance desc,kp.id limit #{limit}

with eligible as ( select distinct on(q.id) q.id question_id,r.id question_revision_id,q.exam_subject_id, coalesce(nullif(btrim(q.evidence_group_key),''),concat('Q:',q.id)) evidence_group_key, coalesce(r.difficulty,'medium') difficulty,coalesce(r.estimated_seconds,60) estimated_seconds, jsonb_build_object('schema_version','1.0','questionType','CHOICE','stem',r.stem, 'options',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label',o.option_label,'content',o.option_text, 'sortOrder',o.sort_order) order by o.sort_order,o.id) from cm_question_option o where o.question_revision_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb), 'images',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceUrl',im.source_url, 'storagePath',im.storage_path,'altText',im.alt_text,'sortOrder',im.image_order) order by im.image_order,im.id) from cm_question_image im where im.question_revision_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb))::text presentation_snapshot, jsonb_build_object('schema_version','1.0','questionType','CHOICE','answer',r.answer, 'analysis',r.analysis,'rules',jsonb_build_object('selectionMode','single'))::text grading_snapshot, jsonb_build_object('schema_version','1.0','items',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object( 'knowledgePointId',#{knowledgePointId}::text, 'knowledgePointName',(select kp.syllabus_title from cm_knowledge_point kp where kp.id=#{knowledgePointId}), 'examSubjectId',q.exam_subject_id::text)))::text knowledge_snapshot, last_submit.last_submitted from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_question q on q.id=qk.question_id and q.del_flag='0' join cm_question_revision r on r.id=qk.question_revision_id and r.status='published' left join lateral (select max(qa.submitted_time) last_submitted from cm_session_question sq join cm_question_attempt qa on qa.session_question_id=sq.id and qa.user_id=#{userId} where sq.question_id=q.id and qa.status='submitted') last_submit on true where qk.knowledge_point_id=#{knowledgePointId} and r.question_type='CHOICE' and jsonb_typeof(r.answer)='object' and jsonb_typeof(r.answer->'value')='array' and jsonb_exists(r.answer, 'schema_version') and r.answer->>'answer_type'='option_keys' and r.answer->>'selection_mode'='single' and jsonb_array_length(r.answer->'value')=1 and exists(select 1 from cm_question_option o where o.question_revision_id=r.id) and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(r.answer->'value') answer(label) where not exists(select 1 from cm_question_option o where o.question_revision_id=r.id and o.option_label=answer.label)) and not exists(select 1 from cm_learning_task t join cm_task_item ti on ti.task_id=t.id join cm_task_question tq on tq.task_item_id=ti.id and tq.question_id=q.id where t.user_id=#{userId} and t.goal_id=#{goalId} and ) order by q.id,r.revision_no desc,r.id desc ) select * from eligible order by (last_submitted is null) desc,last_submitted asc,question_id limit #{limit}
